## TotemVanillaTweaks 0.1.24

- Moves active VanillaTweaks payload, advancement, locale, and manual IDs to
  the canonical Totem namespace.
- Keeps legacy advancement definitions unreadable by normal gameplay and only
  available to the one-way migration path.
- Rebuilds the Observer integration lockstep against the canonical-ID release
  bundle, including TotemCore 0.7.18 and the current owning modules.

Minecraft 26.2 · Fabric · Java 25 · requires TotemCore 0.7.18 or newer within
the 0.7.x compatibility line.
